title: DCC address pools
helpMessage: On this page you can easily plan vehicle addressing on the layout
intro: Every vehicle needs an assigned DCC address to be controlled. Users have assigned address pools so they do not conflict with each other. Manage DCC addresses, plan addressing, release addresses — this view keeps everything under control.

releaseConfirm.title: Release DCC addresses
releaseConfirm.body_one: Are you sure you want to remove the DCC address from {{count}} vehicle? Vehicles in motion will be stopped.
releaseConfirm.body_other: Are you sure you want to remove the DCC address from {{count}} vehicles? Vehicles in motion will be stopped.
